title: AI Brand Awareness Video Creation
desc:
I want to boost my brand’s visibility through compelling AI-driven video content. The goal is simple: create short, attention-grabbing videos that will circulate on social channels and reinforce who we are and what we stand for. Because I’m focused on brand awareness, every clip needs to look polished, on-message, and unmistakably ours.

Here’s what I need from you: conceive, script if necessary, and produce a series of AI videos—think the modern, synthetic-media style made possible with tools like Synthesia, Runway, or any platform you’re comfortable with. The final edits should be ready to post (preferably in 1080×1080 and 1920×1080) and include light motion graphics, captions, and subtle branding elements so the audience instantly recognizes us.

title: AI Video Shorts Automation
desc:
I want a single AI-powered workflow that turns my raw footage or text prompts into entertainment-style YouTube Shorts, polishes longer videos, and then posts everything automatically to both YouTube and Instagram. 

Here’s what matters to me:
• The agent must be able to create Shorts from scratch or from supplied clips, matching the fast-paced, hook-heavy style that performs well in the entertainment niche.  
• Built-in editing should cover subtitles, music or sound-effect beds, and eye-catching visual effects without manual touch-ups.

I’m open to whatever stack you prefer—whether that’s Python scripts with ffmpeg, OpenAI/Whisper for transcription, or a no-code automation platform—as long as the final result is reliable and repeatable. 

Acceptance criteria  
1. I can drop footage or a prompt into a folder or dashboard and receive an edited Short and/or full video.  
2. Subtitles are accurate, timed correctly, and styled to brand guidelines.  
3. Music/SFX and visual effects are synced and royalty-safe.  
4. The finished asset appears on my YouTube and Instagram accounts with the right metadata, either immediately or at a scheduled time I choose.

All you need is perfect fluency in both languages, a quiet workspace and solid internet. If you enjoy friendly customer interactions and have a knack for accurate scheduling, I’d love to work with you.

title: Fantasy Box Illustration Design
desc:
I need a wrap-around illustration for my product box that instantly transports the viewer into a magical realm.

Once we begin, I’ll share the dieline, dimensions, and mood-board so you can sketch an initial concept directly in CorelDRAW. The final deliverable must be an editable, print-ready CDR file prepared in CMYK at 300 dpi with proper bleed and safety margins.

Deliverables
• One concept sketch for approval  
• Final high-resolution CorelDRAW file aligned to the box dieline  
• Up to two revision rounds to fine-tune color, detail, and placement  

If you excel at detailed illustration, love fantasy themes, and are comfortable working natively in CDR, I’m excited to see how you can turn this box into a piece of art.

title: Property Management Inquiry Calls (cold calling, mystery shopper)
desc:
I have a short-notice assignment for someone who is physically in the United States and able to pick up the phone right away. I will hand you about ten contact numbers of a management companies that handles rentals and I will give you an address of a house you "want to buy". You simply play the role of a prospective buyer who wants the firm to manage the property once it is purchased.  

Your only goal on each call is to gather clear, conversational answers on what they charge, what those fees cover, and any onboarding or contract terms they consider standard. Please sound natural—never hint that you are conducting a survey—and keep the chat focused on their service packages for a single home.  

The numbers can be worked through in roughly two to three hours, and I need your call notes back—brief but complete—no later than 6 p.m. New York time today. I will give you the online survey link with all the questions (you will put the answers there).  

If you are located in the U.S. and can start immediately, message me and I will forward the property address and a quick calling script to help you open the conversation.

title: Professional Instagram Setup for Web Dev -- 2
desc:

desc:

title: Lead-Driving Website Traffic Boost
desc:
My site gets visitors, but I need many more of the right ones—people ready to leave their details so my sales team can step in. The core objective is simple: generate qualified leads.

Right now I rely on a blend of social media, email marketing and search-engine visibility. Video is the star of our content mix, so any plan you propose has to maximise its reach and conversion power. I’m open to expanding into complementary formats if you can prove they will accelerate lead flow, yet video must stay central.

What I expect from you
• A clear, data-backed traffic growth strategy that integrates seamlessly with the channels already in play.  
• Tactical recommendations for optimising or scaling campaigns—including creative tweaks, placement strategy, funnel adjustments and tracking setup—so each visitor moves smoothly toward a lead form.  
• Implementation support: from keyword research and social ad builds to email segmentation and A/B tests, whatever will push volumes up and acquisition costs down.  
• Transparent reporting that ties results directly to leads generated, not just raw traffic.

Success will be measured by the uplift in qualified leads within an agreed timeframe, verified through our CRM. If you can bring fresh ideas, execute quickly and prove ROI with hard numbers, let’s talk.

title: Blueprint Millwork Bid Estimator
desc:
I need an experienced millwork estimator who can turn the commercial and residential plan sets I receive from general contractors into winning bids. Every job arrives as a PDF blueprint package, accompanied by material specifications, and often includes Division 6 finished carpentry details. Your task is to read those drawings, create precise quantity take-offs, and price out cabinetry, trim, and molding so I can submit confident numbers that keep us competitive yet profitable.  

You’ll be working on both multi-family and single-family projects as well as retail, office, and hospitality interiors, so versatility is essential. I’m interested in someone who is comfortable measuring digitally (PlanSwift, Bluebeam, On-Screen Takeoff, or similar), building clear cost breakdowns in Excel, and flagging any scope gaps or value-engineering opportunities you notice. Turnaround time is critical; most packages need to be costed within a few days of receipt so we never miss a bid date.  

Deliverables I expect for each project:  
• Itemized material and labor take-off with units clearly shown  
• Summary cost sheet ready to drop into my bid form  
• List of assumptions, exclusions, and RFIs  
• Suggested alternates or savings ideas if you see them  

Accuracy within a reasonable estimating margin is the main acceptance criterion, and I’ll review your first submission together so we’re on the same page. If you have questions as you work, ask early—communication is key. I’ll supply the dra

title: SolidWorks Load-Bearing Part Design
desc:
I have an idea for a mechanical part that must both carry significant load and allow controlled movement, and I need a SolidWorks expert to turn this concept into a sound, manufacturable model. Function is the priority—I’m less concerned with surface styling and much more with strength, clearances, and real-world assembly.

You’ll start from my sketches and notes, discuss material and fastening options with me, and then build a fully-parametric SolidWorks model that shows exactly how the part will handle both the load-bearing requirements and the necessary range of motion. If you have access to Simulation or a similar FEA add-in, I’d like to see basic stress results to confirm the concept before we move on to detailing.

Deliverables I need:
• Native SolidWorks (.sldprt / .sldasm) and neutral STEP files  
• Dimensioned fabrication drawings with tolerances and a brief BOM  
• A short PDF/PNG report or screen captures of any FEA you run, highlighting key stresses and safety factors  

That’s all—straightforward, functional, and ready for prototyping once you’re done. If you’ve tackled similar dual-purpose components before, I’d love to see a sample when we talk.

title: Female Manual Data Entry Needed
desc:
I have a collection of digital documents that contain both text and numbers, and I need every line transferred accurately into a structured spreadsheet. Because the files are already in electronic form, there is no scanning or OCR involved—just careful, manual input. Accuracy matters more than speed; transposed figures or misplaced words will cause issues down the line, so I will be double-checking your work against the originals.

You will receive:  
• A shared folder with the source PDFs and DOCX files  
• A pre-formatted Excel/Google Sheet that shows exactly where each field belongs (dates, names, amounts, notes, etc.)  

Your task is to copy the mixed data into its matching columns, apply the basic formatting that the template already uses, and flag anything that looks incomplete or unclear.

I prefer to collaborate with a female freelancer for this project. Good communication and a quick response time are essential; let me know as soon as a file is finished so I can review it and release the next batch.

Deliverable: one clean, fully populated spreadsheet that mirrors the supplied template, ready for immediate use.

If you can start right away and are confident you can keep errors to a minimum, I’d love to work with you.

title: Entertaining Tech Blog Posts
desc:
I’m putting together a series of technology-focused blog posts whose sole purpose is to entertain. Think punchy, conversational pieces that make readers smile while they learn about the latest gadgets, apps or AI trends. Each article should balance light-hearted storytelling with accurate, up-to-date tech insights so the audience walks away amused and a little bit wiser.

You’ll handle the full writing cycle: topic research, catchy headline creation, drafting, a quick round of revisions after feedback, and final delivery ready for upload to WordPress. SEO best practices (keywords, meta description, internal links) need to be woven in naturally, but humour and readability remain the priority.

Deliverables  
• 4 initial blog posts, 800–1,000 words each  
• Engaging, SEO-optimised headline and meta description per post  
• Royalty-free visuals suggested or sourced (just the links are fine)  
• Google Doc share link plus a clean HTML version for easy copy-paste into the CMS

Acceptance criteria  
• Factual accuracy on all tech references, with credible source links  
• Tone stays light, witty and reader-friendly; no jargon left unexplained  
• Grammarly score 95+ and passes Copyscape for originality  

Timelines are flexible within a two-week window for the first batch, and we can discuss an ongoing schedule if the style clicks. If you love geeking out over technology news and can spin it into entertainment, I’m eager to read your work.

title: Surreal Cosmic Meditation Shorts Creation
desc:

You’ll receive a spreadsheet with time-stamped segments (each 60–120 seconds), the raw audio files, and their transcripts; your mission is to transform every clip into a visually hypnotic journey that feels both spiritual and futuristic.

Here’s the creative direction: think cosmic or outer-space rather than generic stock footage. Nebulas swirling to the beat, particles forming sacred geometry, stardust pulsing in sync with a mantra—anything that instantly signals “transcendence” while remaining tasteful and calming. I’m not looking for cookie-cutter templates; the visuals should feel generated specifically for each snippet. No restriction on whether you use Runway Gen-2, Stable Diffusion/ComfyUI with Deforum, or a custom pipeline of your choice. Post-work in After Effects, Premiere, or DaVinci is fine as long as the final result is 9:16, 1080 × 1920, ready to post, and under 60 MB. Light background music will be needed.

Captions will be provided (in the form of transcripts) and will be needed in the videos.

Deliverables (per clip):
• 1 AI-generated video, 60–120 s, 9:16, H.264 MP4, with captions  
• Matching file name to the provided timestamp ID  

I will review the first three clips before green-lighting the remaining batch to ensure style alignment. Final hand-off is a cloud folder cont

• Professional editing in Adobe Premiere or DaVinci Resolve, colour-graded and sound-mixed for streaming and download platforms

I’ll secure talent and locations; you handle crew, gear, and the creative flow on set. If you have a reel that shows romance-focused adult work—or mainstream romantic cinematography that demonstrates the same mood—please share it when you respond.

desc:
I run SpellOut.in, an AI-driven legal-tech platform, and I want every user interaction mapped clearly in Figma so my development team can move fast with confidence. The priority is the Workflow module; that single area handles everything our users do once they land, so the flow must feel effortless and self-explanatory.

Here is what I need from you:  
• A complete, clickable flow in Figma that walks through each state of the Workflow module—from the moment a visitor lands to the point they finish a task and log out.  
• Consistent components, styles, and naming so developers can grab assets without guesswork.  
• Desktop and mobile frames joined by smart, intuitive transitions, with edge cases (errors, empty states, loading) covered as well.  

I will provide the current site, brand colours, copy, and AI prompts as soon as we start; you will return a shareable Figma link plus a brief hand-off note explaining the structure.

My acceptance criteria are simple: every screen connected, no dead ends, and clear annotations that show how data flows between steps.

Timelines are flexible but I value quick, iterative check-ins—call or WhatsApp me on +91-8130527381 to discuss scope and milestones in more detail.

title: Fragrantica Database CSV Extraction
desc:
I need a complete, one-time scrape of every fragrance listing on Fragrantica and nothing else—strictly factual catalogue information, no user reviews or personal data. The final deliverable should be a single, well-structured CSV file.

Required columns, in this exact order:  
id, name, brand, gender, release_date, description, accords, notes, image_url.  

Key points  
• One-time extraction only; no ongoing sync.  
• For the image field I just need the direct URL, please do not download or embed the files.  
• Make sure text is clean (no HTML tags, line-break clutter, or duplicated records).  
• Python with Scrapy or BeautifulSoup is fine, as long as the script is reproducible so I can rerun it if Fragrantica changes something in the future.  

Before hand-off, spot-check a few random entries against the live site so we both know everything lines up. Once the CSV passes that sanity check, the job is done.
